build_get_api_base: build a call to get_api_base to resolve the OpenAI API base URL from config or environment
create_get_api_key: create a call to get_api_key to resolve the OpenAI API key from config or environment
test_get_complete_url: test get_complete_url to build the client_secrets endpoint URL for OpenAI realtime
run_get_realtime_calls_url: run get_realtime_calls_url to build the realtime calls endpoint URL for OpenAI
review_validate_environment: review validate_environment to build HTTP headers with Bearer authorization and content type
